intro: Built for sharing and eating late: tapas, cured ham, seafood and rice, with olive oil and smoked paprika running through it all.
flavours: Olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika (pimentón), saffron, sherry
hk: Tapas bars are a Hong Kong after-work favourite, especially around Soho and Wan Chai.

dishes.name: Paella
dishes.what: Saffron rice cooked in a wide, shallow pan; the original Valencian version has chicken and rabbit, not seafood. The crust on the bottom is the socarrat.

dishes.name: Tortilla española
dishes.what: Thick, golden omelette of potatoes (and, hotly debated, onion), served in wedges.

dishes.name: Jamón ibérico
dishes.what: Cured ham from black Iberian pigs, the best fed on acorns (bellota), sliced paper-thin.

dishes.name: Patatas bravas
dishes.what: Fried potato chunks with spicy tomato sauce and often aioli.

dishes.name: Gambas al ajillo
dishes.what: Prawns sizzling in garlic-and-chilli olive oil; mop it up with bread.

dishes.name: Pulpo a la gallega
dishes.what: Galician octopus sliced over potatoes with olive oil and paprika.

dishes.name: Croquetas
dishes.what: Crisp fried croquettes with a molten béchamel centre, often with ham.

dishes.name: Gazpacho
dishes.what: Chilled Andalusian soup of raw blended tomatoes and vegetables.

dishes.name: Pimientos de Padrón
dishes.what: Blistered little green peppers with sea salt; most are mild, one in a while is hot.

dishes.name: Churros con chocolate
dishes.what: Fried dough sticks dunked in thick hot chocolate.
